definition: 560 profissionais empregados por 42 companies producing game software (games or part of them). This is an Abragames-reported employment stock for the stated company set, not a documented census or extrapolated national total; the report separately thanks 32 respondent companies and does not reconcile that number with the 42-company headline. It says 'empregados' and does not say whether founders/partners are included.

source_locator: PDF printed pp. 31-32 methodology; printed p. 39, section 4.3.2 'Proporção entre funcionários e sócios'
definition: Reported total workforce at 133 valid responding Brazilian game-developer companies: 392 sócios (partners/founders) plus 741 colaboradores (staff/collaborators). The publisher calls this a census but the employment number is a respondent sum, not an extrapolation to all Brazilian developers. Fieldwork occurred in January 2014; 2013 is the revenue reference year elsewhere in the report and must not be applied to this workforce value.
